SELECT carrier, orders_fully_delivered, avg_delivery_days, pct_within_5_days, share_of_orders_pct
FROM (
  SELECT
    carrier,
    orders_fully_delivered,
    avg_delivery_days,
    pct_within_5_days,
    share_of_orders_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.carrier AS carrier,
      COUNT(*) AS orders_fully_delivered,
      ROUND(CAST(AVG(d.delivery_days) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_delivery_days,
      ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_days <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_within_5_days,
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM (
          SELECT o2.id AS order_id
          FROM orders o2
          JOIN fulfillments f2a ON f2a.order_id = o2.id
          JOIN shipments s2a ON s2a.fulfillment_id = f2a.id
          WHERE o2.status = 'fulfilled'
            AND o2.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
            AND o2.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
            AND s2a.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
            AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillments ff WHERE ff.order_id = o2.id) = 1
            AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments ss WHERE ss.fulfillment_id = f2a.id) = 1
        ) all_d
      ), 1) AS share_of_orders_pct
    FROM (
      SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        s.carrier AS carrier,
        (CAST(s.delivered_at AS DATE) - CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)) AS delivery_days
      FROM orders o
      JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.id
      JOIN shipments s ON s.fulfillment_id = f.id
      WHERE o.status = 'fulfilled'
        AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillments f2 WHERE f2.order_id = o.id) = 1
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.fulfillment_id = f.id) = 1
    ) d
    GROUP BY d.carrier
  ) per_carrier

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    'ALL CARRIERS' AS carrier,
    orders_fully_delivered,
    avg_delivery_days,
    pct_within_5_days,
    100.0 AS share_of_orders_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS orders_fully_delivered,
      ROUND(CAST(AVG(delivery_days) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_delivery_days,
      ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_days <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_within_5_days
    FROM (
      SELECT
        (CAST(s.delivered_at AS DATE) - CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)) AS delivery_days
      FROM orders o
      JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.id
      JOIN shipments s ON s.fulfillment_id = f.id
      WHERE o.status = 'fulfilled'
        AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fulfillments f2 WHERE f2.order_id = o.id) = 1
        AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments s2 WHERE s2.fulfillment_id = f.id) = 1
    ) all_orders
  ) totals
) combined
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN carrier = 'ALL CARRIERS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  orders_fully_delivered DESC,
  carrier ASC
note: Scoped exactly as specified: orders placed in 2025, status='fulfilled', exactly one fulfillment with exactly one shipment, delivered_at not null, delivery_days = date(delivered_at) - date(placed_at). share_of_orders_pct is each carrier's share of this clean population (denominator is the same filtered set, not all orders tenant-wide), and the ALL CARRIERS row re-aggregates the identical population so it sums correctly against the carrier rows.
